sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Determinants as Area
lecture_lines: Determinant represents area of a parallelogram.
Vectors spanning space define an area.
Non-zero determinant means vectors are independent.
animations: Draw a 2D parallelogram defined by column vectors of A using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg].
Label the enclosed area as "Area" with color #FFD700.
Highlight vectors to show linear independence with color #00FFFF.

sections.title: Visualizing the System Ax = b
lecture_lines: Linear system Ax = b combines vectors.
x and y are scalar weights.
Scaling vectors reaches target point b.
animations: Animate vectors forming a parallelogram showing the combination.
Display x and y scalar weights next to vectors in #FFD700.
Scale vectors to reach target point b, highlighting the destination in #00FF00.

sections.title: The Geometry of the Numerator
lecture_lines: To solve for x, substitute column.
This new parallelogram represents the numerator.
animations: Highlight the substituted column vector in the matrix A.
Display the new parallelogram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] representing the numerator.
Animate scaling effect comparing new area to original with color #FFD700.

sections.title: Synthesis: The Ratio Formula
lecture_lines: Cramer's Rule is a ratio of areas.
animations: Display the ratio formula: x_1 = det(A_1)/det(A) in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Compare area of numerator versus denominator geometrically.
Flash final solution x_1 in #00FF00 to confirm completion [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
